evals.prompt: Give me a starting vocal chain for a mono rap lead in Reason 12.7. Only stock devices. Order, device names, settings. Keep it short.
evals.expected_output: HPF 60-100 Hz, de-ess before compressors, mud cut, presence, two gentle 2:1 stages, reverb/delay on sends, level matching, no 13/14 devices.
assertions: Sets a high-pass filter somewhere between 60 and 100 Hz
Puts de-essing before the compressors (mixer 'Filters To Dyn S/C' (also spelled 'Filters Dyn S/C') or an equivalent sidechain de-esser)
Uses two gentle compression stages (around 2:1, about 2 dB each) rather than one heavy compressor
Puts reverb and delay on sends, not as inserts on the vocal channel
Does not use Reason 13/14-only devices (Gain Tool, Stereo Tool, Sidechain Tool, Ripley, RV-9)
Says the settings are starting points to adjust by ear or mentions level-matching before judging
Keeps the lead centered/mono and puts width in the sends or tells him not to widen the lead
Does not rely on the channel strip's own HPF for the rumble cut while ALSO using the strip's Filters To Dyn S/C de-esser (rumble cut is in a separate EQ device, or no strip de-esser is used)

evals.prompt: Neptune makes my vocal sound robotic. I want it natural, and I also want a quiet octave-up double under the chorus. How do I do both in Reason 12.7?
evals.expected_output: Natural: Neptune insert, Scale set, moderate Correction Speed, Formant on. Octave: Neptune on a send, Pitch Adjust off, Transpose on, Semi +12.
assertions: For the natural sound: Neptune as an insert with the Scale set, a moderate (not maximum) Correction Speed, and the Formant section on
For the octave: Neptune on a SEND (not the insert), Pitch Adjust OFF, Transpose ON, Semitones (Semi) set to +12
Tells him to balance the octave double with the channel's send knob so it is quiet
Uses at least three real Neptune control names (Correction Speed, Formant, Transpose, Semitones, Pitch Adjust, Preserve Expression, Scale)

evals.prompt: How do I make a talking-synth robot voice with the vocoder in Reason 12.7? I'm singing into my audio interface.
evals.expected_output: BV512 with a synth carrier, voice into Modulator Input, Dry/Wet fully wet, play notes on the carrier.
assertions: Explains two signals: a synth as the carrier and his voice as the modulator (the roles are explicit)
Says the carrier synth must play notes or nothing is heard
Patches the audio interface input to the BV512's Modulator Input (back panel)
Names the BV512 vocoder (not a Reason 13/14-only device)
